lin: Kati na biso na mokolo ya lelo bokonzi ya bato ezali kokoba koleka lolenge ya kala.

en: Nowadays, almost all cars have a GPS.
lin: Na mikolo mya lelo, ba mituka nyonso ezali mingi mingi na GPS.

en: My uncle vouched for my debts.
lin: Noko na ngai andimaki ete akofuta ba niongo na ngai.

en: We could hear wolves howling in the distance.
lin: Tokokaki koyoka ba mbwa ya zamba konganga na musika.

en: Medical marijuana is legal in this state.
lin: Diamba pona kobikisa endingisami na Mbula matari.

en: The fire reduced the entire village to ashes.
lin: Moto ekomisi mboka nyonso putulu.

en: He was totally hitting on you at the bar.
lin: Azalai kotia yo litoyo penza, na ekala.

en: The company issued a press release.
lin: Kompanyi esilaki kopesa nsango ezalaki kowuta na ba panzi nsango.

en: The angry crowd was throwing objects at the police.
lin: Lisanga ya bato na nkanda bazalaki kobamba mabanga na ba pulusu.

en: We sang songs together in a chorus.
lin: Tozalaki koyemba ba nzembo na lolenge ya lisanga.

en: If you go underwater, hold your breath and blow out to unblock your ears.
lin: Soki okayi na nse ya mayi, kanga mpema mya yo mpe bimisa mpema pona ete matoyi mya yo ma fungwama.

en: She often talks about her fiancé.
lin: Abetaka mingi lisolo ya likangu na ye.

en: It's my special recipe, rabbit stew.
lin: Oyo ezali elubu na ngai ya ntina, soupou ya lapin.

en: Greece is taking radical measures to avoid the collapse of its financial system.
lin: Grèce azali kozwa mikano ya kafu kafu pona kobatela bokasi ya mosolo mya maye matali misolo mya ye.

en: I would also like to take this opportunity to tell that arrogant guy, who I hope is listening to this program, that everyone is fed up with his haughty comments and that we all want to see him go.
lin: Nakolinga zwa eposa (opportunite) oyo, na lolenge moko, pona koyebisa moto ya lelendo oyo, na banzi, azolanda mabongisi oyo, ete bato nyonso balembi maloba mya ye ya lolendo mpe tolingi komona ye akende.

en: Moaning, weeping, praying is likewise cowardly. Vigorously carry out your long and heavy task, on the path where Fate has chosen to call you, then afterward, like me, suffer and die without complaint.
lin: Komilela lela, kolela, kosambela ezali mpe lokola goigoi. Sala mosala mya yo na makasi nyonso na lolenge oyo esengeli, ndenge etinda na yo na mokili esengeli, mpe na sima, lokola ngai, nyokwama mpe kufa koloba eloko te.

en: Sorry, honey, there's no way I can spend a whole evening chatting over cocktails.
lin: Bolimbisi, bolingo, ezali na lolenge moko te oyo nakoki kozwa mpokwa mobimba pona lisolo pembeni ya nkopo ya masanga.

en: Latin uses 23 letters: a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, x, y, z.
lin: Latin esalelaka ba nkoma ntúkú míbalé na mísáto : a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, k, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, x, y, z.

en: At times he told himself that letting such a beautiful woman go out alone in Paris like that was as reckless as leaving a jewelry box full of jewels in the middle of the street.
lin: Ba ntangu misusu azalaki komilobela ete kotika muasi kitoko lolenge oyo kobima ye moko na Paris ezalaki likanisi ya kozanga ekenge ndenge moko na kotika sanduku ya ba biju ya motuya na kati kati ya bala bala.

en: The Japanese tend to want to know certain personal information about someone, such as their age, social status, and whether or not they're married, before feeling comfortable talking with a foreigner.
lin: Ba Japonais bazalaka na bizaleli ya koluka koyeba mingi maye matali mutu lokola mbula naye, bozwi naye, soki abala to te, liboso ba ndima kosolola na mopaya.

en: Aeneas emerges from the cloud and appears suddenly; he pays his compliments to the queen, who gives him a very warm welcome, and he hastens to send provisions of every kind to his companions who remained on the shore.
lin: Énée abimi na mapata mpe abimi na pwasa ; apesi ya ye longonya na muasi ya mokonzi, oyo asalelaki ye nteke ya malonga, mpe awelisi kotindela biloko ya lolenge nyonso na ba ninga na ye oyo batikalaki na  pembeni ya mayi.

en: To end up naked, suffocating in a padlocked gym bag, with the key to the padlock under your buttocks, inside the bag, you'd have to be an English spy, right?
lin: Po ete omonisma motakala, yako kangelama mpe kozanga lolenge ya koppema okati ya sacoche na cadena, fungola ya cadena na nse ya masoko, okati ya sacoche, sengeli ozala espion ya ba anglais, bongo te?

en: It's clear that Americans can't even solve their own problems. So how can they possibly think they're capable of handling the problems of the rest of the world?
lin: Ezali komonisema na pole ete ba Américains bazali na makoki yako silisa makambo na bango moko te. Boni boni bakoki kozala na makanisi yako banza ete bakoki kosilisa makambu ya mokili misusu?

en: But listen, and learn by what certain signs these places promised by fate will make themselves known.
lin: " Kasi yoka, mpe yabe na bilembo nini basusu / bako yebisa bisika oyo abingisamaki na bomoi na bango. "

en: As for me, rather than trying to be a cosmopolitan, likeable man, I would like to be someone from the land with an open mind.
lin: Pona ngai, bisika ya komeka kozala moto awuti na engumba monene mpe azali malamu, nakosepela kozala moto awuti mboka kasi atoondisami na makanisi.

en: Unfortunately, the police had to wait for another victim before trying to learn more about the serial killer.
lin: Mawa po ete, pulusu ezelaki ete moto musus akufa yambo ba luka koyeba nani zalaki mobomi ya ba mbala ebele.

en: After the destruction of the Second World War in the city center, many new buildings appeared. However, some beautiful old residences still exist in a few places.
lin: Sima ya bopanzi oyo eselamaki na bitumba ya mokili mobimba pona ntangu ya mibale na centre-ville, ba ndako ya siika mamonisamaki. Kasi ba ndako misusu mya kala masili kozala na bisika misusu.

en: You want answers to questions you shouldn't be asking.
lin: Bolingi biyano na mituna oyo esengelaki botuna te.

en: The car is parked in Zone E, spot 97. Exit through the main entrance, turn right, and go to the end of the terminal.
lin: Motuka etelemisami na Zone E, place 97. Bima na nzela ya monene ya kokotela, baluka na loboko ya mobali mpe kende ti na suka ya terminal.

en: Never pass in front of any church without reverently greeting and worshiping Jesus Christ who rests there, and honoring the Saint to whom it is dedicated: show the same respect to the crosses you encounter.
lin: Kolekaka soki mokolo moko te liboso ya ecclezia mpe opesa mbote ya botosi to mpe osanjola Yezu te oyo azali kopema kuna, mpe kumisa mosantu oyo ecclesia epesameli : lakisa botosi na ba ekuluzu nyonso ozali komona na nxela na yo.

en: Don't you remember that singer from back then, Komuro or Himuro, I don't really remember, who did some weird dance?
lin: Oza kanisa lisusu mooyembi ya muasi oyo te na ntangu  wana, Komuro ou Himuro,nayebi te soki na tangi ye malamu, oyo azalaki kosala mabima moko ya ndenge ?

en: Even though the two boys hadn't liked each other's partner at first, they quickly became friends.
lin: Ata soki bana ya mibali mibale ya mikie bazalaki kolinga molongani ya moko moko te, bakomaki ba ninga na sima.

en: Yesterday we went to a classical music concert. During the first part, they played something sad — I almost fell asleep; the second part was a bit more cheerful.
lin: Lobi tokendaki mindule ya miziki ya mindele. Na ntangu ya eteni ya yambo, babetaki betaki eloko moko ya mawa - na komaki pene ya kolala ; eteni ya mibale nde ezali mwa moke na esengo.

en: With the past no longer illuminating the future, the mind walks in darkness.
lin: Ntangu eleka ezali kopesa pole lisusu te na ntangu ekoya, molimo ezali kotambola na molili.

en: Hey, wait a minute. I hope you're not trying to tell me that you're not going to pay me back my money.
lin: Eh, zela ngonga moko. Nabanzi ozali komeka  koyebisa ngai ete okozongisela ngai mosolo na ngai te.

en: Aeneas first sees to providing for his companions' immediate needs; he goes hunting and kills several deer, which he distributes to them; he then offers them some words of encouragement.
lin: Énée azali kolengele nanu ba ninga na ye na bopesi bango biye bisengeli ya yambo ; azali kokende bokila, mpe koboma ba mboloko ebele oyo azali kokabolela bango; sima na yango ayebisi bango ba yika mpiko.

en: There he takes aboard an unfortunate Greek from Ulysses's company, named Achaemenides, who had been left on that shore, abandoned by his companions.
lin: Kuna asili koyamba epayi na ye moto ya mawa moko ya greki oyo azalaki na lingomba ya Ulysse, na kombo ya Acheménide, oyo atikalaki na libongo wana mpo baninga naye basundolaki ye.

en: Once you've made Berthe sick, you'll have to call the doctor, it'll cost money at the pharmacist's, and once again you'll be the one left holding the bag...
lin: Ntangu okobelisa Berthe, esengeli obenga dokotolo, ekosenga misolo epayi ya moteki nkisi (pharmacien), mpe ekozala yo lisusu moto okobima zoba...

en: Do you remember "Wacky Races"? Look at the primary in the United States of America — it looks awfully similar!
lin: Ozali koyeba lisusu « Batu ya maboma oyo bazalaki kokumba » ? Tala ba maponami ya liboso ya America, ezali penza kokokana !

en: Below, sword in hand, fearless cohorts crowd inside and guard the gates. My fury awakens in these moments of terror; I fly to their aid, to the aid of my king.
lin: Soki okiti mingi na nse, libende na maboko, Lisanga ya bato ya mpiko / ba kokende na lobango na kati, mpe kobatela bikuke. / Nkanda na ngai elamuki na ba ntangu oyo ya bobangi ; / na keyi kosunga bango, kosunga mokinzi na ngai.

en: Well, if it keeps snowing, Santa Claus won't be able to arrive on time.
lin: Na yango, soki neige ezali kokweya kaka, père Noël akokoka kokoma na ntangu te.

en: Ah! You want to escape, you vile creature! You're trying to flee like a thief, in the middle of the night, huh?
lin: Ah ! Olingi okima, ekelamu mabe ! Ozo luka okima lokola moyibi ya muasi, ontei ya butu, hein ?

en: Before retiring, she worked as secretary to the Director of a university research school.
lin: Yambo ete akende na pension, azalaki kosala lokola secretaire ya Directeur ya kelassi pona kosala mabingisami ya université.

en: O you, the love, hope, and pride of the Trojans, Hector, what god returns you to your countrymen? How we have suffered through your long absence! How we have begged for Hector's presence!
lin: " O yo, bolingo, elikya, mpe lolendo ya ba Troyens, / Hector, nzambe nini azongisa yo na bayi mboka mwa yo ? / Ndenge to tungisamaki na ntangu molayi oyo ozalaki musika na biso ! / Nini  lisusu to koki kozenga na Hector soki kobondela bozali na ye te ! "

en: Dan's truck seemed to have vanished without a trace.
lin: Mutuka ya monene ya Dan elimwaki mpe etikaki bilembo te.

en: I Love You is the title of more songs than anyone could sing in their entire lifetime.
lin: "Na lingi yo" ezali nkombo ya ba loyembo oyo moto nyonso akoki koyemba na bomoyi naye mobimba.

en: I left some important company documents at my house. Sorry, but could you please go get them for me now?
lin: Na tiki mikanda misusu ya mituya oyo ya companie na ndaku na ngai. Bolimbisi, kasi okoki, na bondeli yo, kokende kozwa myango sikoyo ?

en: Today's arraignment hearing gives the defendant his first opportunity to present his case in person.
lin: Na ntangu ya esambeli ya lelo botangi ya likambu oyo ba fundeli ekopesa na moto oyo afundami eposa ya liboso po andimbola likambo naye ye moko.

en: Auxerre recorded its first win of the season and, in doing so, climbed out of the relegation zone.
lin: Auxerre asili kozwa elonga naye ya liboso na masango mpe, lolenge wana, aleki mondelo ya motane.

en: You're funny, you! Did you really think I was going to wait for you all afternoon?
lin: Ozali kosekisa, yo ! Obanzaki te ete nalingaki nazela yo mpokwa nyonso ?

en: There's no need to ask him to convince himself that he is, in heart and mind, bound to his class, his working class.
lin: Ezali na ntina te yako senga ye mpo azala na koyeba ete azali, na nzoto mpe molimo, lingomba oyo ye azali, lingomba ya bana ngamba.

en: And why did you think he was my lover? Because his company gave me pleasure? If you were smarter, more pleasant, I would have preferred yours!
lin: Mpona nini okanisaki ete azali linkangu na ngai ? Mpo ete komany na ye ezali kopesa ngai esengo ? Soki ozalaki mayele koleka, malau koleka, nalingaki na pona ya yo !

en: I'll explain the situation to you first, and you can ask me all the questions you want afterward.
lin: Na ndimbolisa yo nanu ba makomi mpe okoki kotuna mituna mya yo na sima.

en: During the day we see the bright sun, and during the night we see the pale moon and the beautiful stars.
lin: Na ntangu ya mokolo tomonaka moi kongenge, mpe ontei ya butu tomonaka sanza mpe minzoto ya kitoko.

en: So, how much have you figured out this month? "Well, you know, I'm like all guys, my outlook only goes twenty-four hours max!"
lin: « Bon, obendi yango boni na sanza oyo ? » « Euh oyebi, nazali lokola mibali nyonso, makanisi mya ngai, esukaka na mokolo ya lelo ! »

en: The company responded to the appeal and will make a donation of twenty-five thousand euros.
lin: Kompany eyanoli na mbela mpe ekosala libonza ya nkóto  ntúkú míbalé na mítáno ya ba euros.

en: On May 18th, a young Japanese couple were arrested after their one-year-old baby was found wrapped in a plastic bag and thrown into a gutter.
lin: Mokolo ya zómi na mwámbe lya sanza mya  mítáno (18 mai), bilenge babale, muasi na mobali ya mboka japon bakangamaki sima ya bokuti muana na bango ya mbula lyoko oyo azalaki okati ya sacoche ya plastiki mpe ba bwakaki ye na matolo bisika ebongisama pona mayi ya mbula elekaka.

en: With Tatoeba on Android, you'll be able to translate Flaubert while making love, thus opening the way to levels of pleasure never explored before...
lin: Na Tatoeba (application ya ba japonais pona kolimbola ba nkota ya ba paya) na lolenge n'ango ya Adroid (ya sika mpe makasi), tokoki kolimbola Flaubert na ntangu yabosangisi nzoto, bongo tokofungola ba nzela mpe ba lolengee ya nsai oyo nanu tomeka te...

en: In New York hotels, men are now advised to get out of their shower fully dressed.
lin: Na ba hôtels na New York, toli epesami bongo na mibali ete babimaka na kikóso na bilamba.

en: Sir William Lucas, formerly a tradesman in Meryton, had made a tidy fortune. Having honorably held the office of mayor, he had been given a knighthood by the king.
lin: M. William Lucas, kala azalaki mutu kosala mombongo na Meryton, azalaki na misolo ebele. Mpo asalaki mosala malamu ya kigouverneur, azwaki ngwende ya ki chevalier epayi ya mokonzi.

en: Standing in front of the open cupboard, Catherine thought it over. There was only a piece of bread left, plenty of cottage cheese, but barely a scrap of butter; and she had to make sandwiches for the four of them.
lin: Liboso ya belei ebele, Catherine azalaki kokanisa. Etikalaki kaka eteni ya mukie ya lipa, fromage ya pembe ya kokoka, kasi mwa ndambu mukie ya manteka ; kasi esengelaki kotia na biteni ya mapa pona bango minei.

en: So you hadn't noticed how beautiful I am? Helene seemed to be telling him. "You hadn't noticed that I am a woman, and a woman that anyone can have, you most of all?" her gaze seemed to say.
lin: « Omoni te lolenge boni nazali kitoko ? ezalaki lokola Hélène azalaki koloba bongo. Ozo mona te nazali muasi mpe muasi oyo moto nyonso akoki kozwa, mingi mingi yo ? » etaleli naye ezalaki koloba bongo.

en: While climbing the tree to show off in front of his girl friends, Gabriel made a complete fool of himself when his trousers caught on a thorn and made a suspicious ripping sound.
lin: Na komata na nzete, pona asepelisa bana basi liboso mya ye, Gabriel amiyokisaki soni na ntangu oyo patalon naye ekangamaki na nzube mpe makele eyokanaki.

en: I used to be in charge of my high school's newsletter — call it a rag if you like — but anyway, that's how my passion for journalism was born.
lin: Ntangu ya kala, nazalaki mokonzi ya lingomba ya ba panzi nsango ya kelassi na ngai, okoki kobenga yango nkasa ya ndunda soki olingi, na lolenge wana mposa na ngai ya kokoma mopanzi nsango ebotamaki.

en: I find it strange that Alice stays silent for so long.
lin: Nazali komonona yango mistiki lolenge Alica azali kovanda kimia ntangu molayi.

en: Sorry, darling, there's no way I can spend a whole evening chatting over cocktails.
lin: Bolimbisi, bolingo, ezali na lolenge moko te oyo nakoki kolekisa butu mobimba pona masolo pembeni ya nkopo ya masanga.

en: As you had requested a detailed account of the facts, we are sending you, enclosed, a note on the matter from the person responsible for the file.
lin: Lokola osengaki makomi oyo mazali kolobela makambo malekaki, to tindeli yo, na pembeni, na yango, mokanda ewuti esika ya moto oyo azali kolandela likambo yina.

en: Listen, Marie, I said to her, clasping her two small hands in mine, "don't you know me at all?" She looked at me with her beautiful eyes, and replied: "Why, no!"
lin: « Yoka, Marie, nazalaki koyebisa ye na ntangu nasimbaki maboko mya ye mibale ya mike na sangisi myango na mya ngai, ozo yeba ngai lisusu te ? » Atali ngai na misu mya ye ya kitoko, mpe ayanoli : « Ah malamu te ! »

en: How come you know so much about French? "Well, I'm French. Of course I know about it." "But even I, who am Japanese, can't explain Japanese as well as that!"
lin: « Ndenge nini osali  mpo ete oyeba lopoto malamu boye  ? » « kasi, nazali Français. Ezali ya kokamwa te ete nayeba yango. » « Kasi ata ngai moko oyo nazali Japonais, nayebi malamu te kondimbolisa kijaponais ! »

en: Looking at this old musical instrument with its wildly twisted shapes, I wondered what mad mind it had come from. "In any case, what a beautiful instrument this is!" I exclaimed.
lin: Nakotala eloko ya ebetelo ya mindule oyo ekomi ya kala na lolenge mya yango enyefuka, nazali komituna ewuti na molimo ninii ya liboma. « Penza, oyo eleko ya ebetele mindule ya kitoko nde yangoyo ! », natikaki.

en: In order to speed up the expulsion of Palestinians from certain areas of the West Bank, the occupying army has turned 18% of this region into training grounds. The roughly 6,000 Palestinians who live there will sooner or later be expelled.
lin: Na ntina ya komisa bobengani ya ba Palestiniens na ba etuku misusu ya Cisjordanie mbangu, mapinga oyo eyingela mpe enganzama ontei ya mboka na bango bakomisaki 18% ya bisika ya etuku ena camp yako salela ba netrainements. Ndambu ya ba palestiens nkóto motóba oyo batikali kovanda kuna bako bengana bango soki lelo te ata lobi.

en: Don't wait for events to happen the way you want; decide to want what happens and you will be happy.
lin: Kozela te ete makambo makomela yo ndenge ozo linga ; zwa mokano ya kolinga maye mazali kokomela yo mpe oko zala na esengo.

en: The vehicle, speeding along, skidded and plowed headfirst into the back of a truck before its driver could say Jack Robinson.
lin: Motuka oyo ezalaki kokumbama na mbangu makasi esietaki mpe ekotisaki liboso nango na sima ya motuka ya monene yambo mokumbi nango akoka koloba Jack Robinson.

en: White then red, nothing moves. Red then white, everything scatters.
lin: Pembe sima motane, eloko tee ezali koningana. Motane sima pembe, nyonso ezali kokima.

en: In Esperanto, you can arrange any sentence according to the six possible word orders: SVO, SOV, VOS, VSO, OVS, OSV, with S for subject, V for verb, and O for object.
lin: na Espéranto, tokoki kobongola maloba nyonso kolanda lolenge oyo elandani : SVO, SOV, VOS, VSO, OVS, OSV, na  S lokola sujet, V pona verbe mpe O pona objet.

en: I suggest you do your job and let me do mine.
lin: Na kosenga nayo osala musala na yo mpe otika ngai nasala ya ngai.

en: Listen to the text that will be read to you, then answer the questions you will be asked.
lin: Yokamela makomi oyo makontangama pona yo, sima yangola mituna oyo bakotuna yo.

en: Come on, get up! Otherwise I won't be able to take you to school.
lin: Tokei, telema ! Soki te nakokoa te komema yo na kelassi.

en: But if the imposing presence of a wise orator appears before their eyes amid the heat of the uproar, they fall silent, they listen, and his winning words govern their minds and win over their hearts.
lin: Kasi na molobeli ya bwanya soki azali kitoko na kotala / kati ya londende ya misu kasi mazali komona, / bakangaka monoko, bayokaka, mpe maloba mya ye ya balongi / ekumbaka milimo mpe mabikisaka mitema.

en: Just as, struck by an uncertain blow from the priest, a proud bull bellows, having escaped the altar — already the intended victim of the raised blade — and has dodged its head from the deceived axe.
lin: Lokola, ebotu oyo tokanaki te ekowuta epayi ya sango, / ngombe ya mobali ya kitoko abimi, akimi esika ba bomaka ba ngombe, / oyo, esi abongisamaki pona kozala libonza,/ mpe epasola ekosamaki elalaki moto na ye.

en: Whoever beats his mother-in-law to death loses his head, beheaded. It's an ancient custom one can understand. But whoever slaughters hundreds of thousands gains a monument.
lin: Oyo nyonso abeti mama bokilo na ye pene ya liwa abungisi moto, bako kata yango. Ezali bongo bizaleli ya kala oyo tokoki kososola. Kasi oyo nyonso ayibi ba nkóto nkámá bakosalela ye monument.

en: In these dreadful moments, was there anyone, man or god, whom I did not implore! No, Ilium in flames, no, that terrible night, held nothing more horrible for this broken heart.
lin: Na bangonga oyo bobangi makasi,/ nani nazalaki kobelela te mpona lisungi ezala batu mpe ba nzambe ! / Te, Ilion ezwi moto, te, butu oyo ezali mobulu,/mpona motema oyo esili kozoka eleko mususu ya mabe koleka ezali te.

en: Dear Mom, I will need your advice as the birth of my baby approaches.
lin: Mama wa ngai ya bolingo, nakozala na posa ya ba toli nayo pembi ya mbotama ya muana na ngai.

en: The prisoner swears on the gospel to faithfully carry out the treaty, giving his sons as hostages, but the day before he signed a secret protest stating that he was abandoning Burgundy under duress.
lin: Mokangemi akati ndayi likolo ya makomi masantu ete akolandela makomi lolenge esengeli, na kopesa bana na ye ya mibali lokola bakangemi, kasi mokolo ya liboso ya mokolo wana atiyaki mokoloto na mokanda ya koboya manso alobaki na ndenge ya nkunku na koloba ete asundoli Bourgogne na makasi.

en: Until then I had never understood why eternity had been made. It's to give some of us a chance to learn German.
lin: Natikalaka kososola te kino lelo mpo na nini bomoyi ya seko esalamaka. Ezali mpo na kotikela basusu kati na biso libaku malamu ya koyekola ki allemand.

en: Sorry, Kylia. "Why are you apologizing?" "No, it's just that I keep thinking I must have bothered you a lot." "Huh? No, come on, not at all."
lin: « Bolimbisi, Kylia. » « Mpo na nini osengi bolimbisi ? » « Te, ezali kaka mpo namilobeli ete natungisi yo mpe mingi. » « Eh ? Ezali bongo te, totala, ata soki moke te. »

en: If a worker who had begun an honestly designed piece of work were to die, any other master craftsman skilled in the subject must be able to continue the work to bring it to completion.
lin: Soki mosali oyo abandaki mosala na lolenge oyo esengeli akufi, esengeli ete molakisi nyonso oyo ayebi mosala yango malamu alandela mosala mpo na kosilisa yango na ndenge esengeli.

en: The five rules of life: §1 Don't think! §2 When you think, don't speak! §3 When you speak, don't write! §4 When you write, don't sign! §5 When you sign, then don't be surprised!
lin: Mateya mitano ya bomoi : §1 Kokanisa te ! §2 Ntango ozali kokanisa, koloba te ! §3 Ntango ozali koloba, kokoma te ! §4 Ntango ozali kokoma, kotiya mokoloto te ! §5 Ntango otie mokoloto, sikoyo kokamwa te !

en: Article 214b, in my opinion one of the even stranger provisions of the General Administrative Code of the Land of Schleswig-Holstein, seems to stipulate that anyone who sees a pink elephant must issue it a receipt.
lin: Nkoma 214b, engebene na likanisi na ngai, moko ya mabongisami ya somo ya Code administratif général ya Land de Schleswig-Holstein, na ndenge emonani koloba ete moto oyo amoni nzoku ya motane esengeli apesa ye mokanda.

en: Alas! With that hope I liked to imagine my revenge; against our past misfortunes I set this joy, and Rome eased the disasters of Troy: yet every day reproduces our misfortunes. Great king! When will you put an end to our sorrows?
